items.summary: Maintain the bounded site-factory pipeline: complicated.work (strongest candidate, score 84), deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net. Keep all three planning-only while delivery remains saturated at 10/10 slots and existing repair, measurement, overlap, legal, security, and rollback obligations remain unresolved. For complicated.work, the readiness artifact must cover the site brief, reusable template, content seed, SEO metadata and crawl baseline, analytics and affiliate readiness using only evidenced data, owner assignment, legal/compliance checklist, security review, measurement plan, rollback boundary, and preview-only launch gate. No domain changes, spending, credentials, deployment, publication, or launch are authorized before owner, legal, security, measurement, and rollback gates pass. Exactly one next step: after CTO releases one delivery slot, assign an owner to complete the complicated.work launch-readiness brief.
